To the Maple community,

Welcome to the Maple Memo, our monthly update. Below, we'll capture what happened this month inside Maple and across the market, and where we're headed next.

Maple highlights

AUM eased in July, then steadied. Our Transparency page (https://d31hK604.eu1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/GG+113/d31hK604/VWdbSq1fZcxsW14v1b88YPT3BW1HN78y5SYGmTN3_3-HT3pyd0W7lCdLW6lZ3pbW988pdt6YSLYLW382ycf2QlrbXW3pZqd-5JwWXWW3R-5JN7c5M3DW8nMn1v3G7xG5W2rcpBS43p323W4jqzfm1yS9CfW8GsnMP1PzXzlW2r03Yc4b5p_6W4RDHcM1JmQtCW3f3DPy426zxDW2QDp_C25z_YlW75_TjP67lVL8W4yzbWY6jVgW5W146qRT2_5m73W1wfv4T4XJwcGW5FcXlM6NLwJ-W1ng0WV4Ry4qgW7DC6y15St6g2W3ZzCgR8pWDSxW1SzDJQ8GnhYKW3cQRrn81Z7zVW6lcgl61GdJLVW5ldbyR6nKcKJf1YlDZP04 ) shows AUM at $4.55B today, slightly down from H1's $4.6B peak after dipping further through July, and recovering since. The fundamentals underneath held up through that stretch: $6.4B in H1 originations, exceeding our full-year 2025 total, and H1 revenue of $12.2M.

syrupUSDG scales rapidly. We launched syrupUSDG from a standing start in July, and it's already up 12% in the past month despite the expected summer slow down. It’s live as collateral behind Robinhood Earn. That yield has staying power too. syrupUSDG has held a 60-90 basis point premium over syrupUSDT every day this month, and stayed ahead of syrupUSDC on most of them. As Sid put it on this month's AMA call, stablecoin yield “continues to be underserved in the market,” and syrupUSDG's growth backs that up.

First buyback under MIP-021. Maple completed its first buyback under the new rules-based framework: 852,840 SYRUP purchased for 136,768 USDT (avg. price $0.1604), 10% of monthly net revenue. We track every buyback in real time on the Transparency page (https://d31hK604.eu1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/GG+113/d31hK604/V

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
